data.exact_reserve_text: During 2014 the Syndicate released GBP 77.4m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods, arising predominantly from the Marine, Property and Treaty Divisions (2013: GBP 79.4m, primarily from the Energy and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses in 2014.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2014 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,332.5m (as at 1 January 2014). During 2014 the Syndicate recorded a net release of prior year technical reserves of GBP 77.4m (a c.5.8% release of opening gross claims outstanding), arising predominantly in the Marine, Property and Treaty divisions. The movement is attributed to favourable claims development on losses in 2014.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' (liabilities) prior year column. Prior year movement taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states a GBP 77.4m release (assumed gross as note refers to technical reserves). LOB-specific amounts for the prior year movement are not quantified in the note. Premium mix read from the segmental analysis table in the notes (scanned document). Minor OCR/scan uncertainty for very small value (Accident and health shown as (0.1) on scan) but totals reconcile to reported gross premiums written.
